title: Your cards. A clearer place to start.
lead: Try ShenTarot with your physical deck, explore your spread, and help us improve the experience.
heroInvite: Have a physical deck? Explore the app beta
contextInvite: Reading with your own deck? See what the app beta offers.
appTitle: Try the app before its public release.
appNote: Check beta access for Android and iPhone. Public-store release is separate from beta testing.
requirements: Access depends on your device, region and the platform invitation. Check the official invitation for current requirements. External pages may use a different language. No website registration is required.
costs: Check the access conditions and any purchase screens in your build. Beta access does not promise permanent free Premium. Ask us if a charge or limit is unclear.
account: Use the same Google account for the tester group, invitation and Google Play on your phone.
androidBodies: Open Google Groups and choose Join group. Group membership alone does not enrol you in the Play test.
Open the Google Play invitation and choose Become a tester. Return here once you have opted in.
Open the listing on your phone. In Google Play, tap your profile image and check that the tester account is selected.
iphoneBodies: Install Apple’s TestFlight app on your iPhone. Installing TestFlight alone does not add ShenTarot.
Open our official invitation on your iPhone. Apple shows current availability and device requirements.
If a compatible build is offered, tap Accept, then Install in TestFlight. Returning testers can use Update or Open.
already: Already in the tester group? Continue to the Google Play invitation.
progress: Progress is saved only in this browser. Confirmations are yours; they do not verify enrolment or installation.
storageFailed: Browser storage is unavailable. You can continue; progress will not be remembered.
saved: Your guide progress has been saved.
copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the visible text instead.
troubleNames: Joined the group but cannot install
Already installed and looking for an update
troubleBodies: Check the invitation’s device and country requirements. On Android, check the Google Play account. Retry the invitation below.
On Android, join the tester group first, then opt in with the same account. On iPhone, check the criteria in Apple’s invitation.
Group membership is only the first step. Open the Play invitation, opt in, and check the account selected in Google Play.
Open the current official invitation below. If it is closed or expired, email us; access cannot be guaranteed.
Open the store or TestFlight with the account used to join. Look for Update or Open. If no build is offered, contact us.
